entries.note: The route's first point: Skif-Cargo collects the cargo from the sender. Reached, it is the collection; not yet reached, a planned step.
A point at one of Skif-Cargo's warehouses on the route, the sending and receiving branches included.
The route's last point: delivery to the consignee. The issue itself is the shipment's state «Груз выдан получателю.» with the issue's date and time.
The shipment's state once issued to the consignee; the reply gives the issue's date and time beside it.
The state the site's account pages give an application not yet handled, which the customer may still cancel there (www.skif-cargo.ru app script).
